run_fit_normalizers_cli: run the fit_normalizers script with a config yaml to compute dataset mean and std
run_fit_norms_with_linref: run fit_norms with a linear reference file to compute element-wise normalized statistics
fit_normalizers_from_config: fit dataset normalizers using a config dict and save the checkpoint to an output path
fit_normalizers_with_override: fit normalizers for specific targets with override values and element references from a dataset
review_fit_norms_function: review the fit_norms function that loads a training dataset and fits normalizers from config
